privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy and KVKK Notice
privacyPolicy.intro: This notice explains how your personal data is processed when you use {{ brand.name }}, under Turkish Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data (KVKK).

controller.title: Data controller
controller.body: Your personal data is processed by the operator of the {{ brand.name }} platform as data controller. For any question or request: {{ email }}.

data.title: Personal data we process
data.body: Depending on your role we process:

items.1: Identity and contact: first name, last name, e-mail address.
items.2: Account: role (student, teacher, private tutor, parent), school, grade, language and theme preference; application details for teacher applications.
items.3: Learning: assigned and solved tests, answers, points, badges, streaks and study time, open-ended answers and teacher feedback.
items.4: Parent link: the link between a parent and a child account and invitation details.
items.5: Correspondence: messages, comments, question and comment reports.
items.6: Private lessons: tutor profile and fee, available hours, lesson requests and approvals, joining video lessons.
items.7: Technical: session and security logs (sign-in times, error logs).

items.1: Open accounts, show the screens for your role and approve teacher accounts.
items.2: Prepare, assign and solve tests and show results to the student, their teacher and their parent.
items.3: Run private lesson bookings and video lessons.
items.4: Send notifications and answer support requests.
items.5: Keep the platform secure and review misuse and reported content.

legalBasis.title: Legal grounds
legalBasis.body: Processing relies on these grounds in Article 5 of the KVKK:

items.1: Establishing and performing the contract to provide the service (Art. 5/2-c).
items.3: Legitimate interest in keeping the platform secure, without harming fundamental rights (Art. 5/2-f).
items.4: Explicit consent for anything outside these grounds; you can withdraw it at any time.

transfer.title: Who it is shared with
transfer.body: Data is never sold or used for advertising. It is shared only:

items.1: Inside the platform as your role requires: a student's results are seen by their teacher and parent, a lesson request by the tutor. The name of a student who reports a question is not shown to the teacher.
items.2: With infrastructure suppliers such as hosting and e-mail, only as far as the service needs.
items.3: Artificial intelligence: question images and texts uploaded by teachers may be sent to AI providers abroad (Anthropic, Google) for subject/topic classification and question detection. Students' identity data and answers are not sent to these services. Transfers abroad follow Article 9 of the KVKK.
items.4: With authorised public bodies when required by law.

collection.title: How data is collected
collection.body: Data is collected from sign-up and profile forms, from what you do on the platform and automatically. The browser only keeps local records for your session and preferences (language, theme, last used settings); no advertising or tracking cookies are used.

children.title: Children's data
children.body: Student accounts open fully after a parent confirms the invitation; until then features such as messaging and private lessons stay off. Parents follow their child's work from their own account and approve private lesson requests.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Data is kept while the account is open. When the account is deleted or the purpose ends it is deleted or anonymised, subject to retention periods required by law.

rights.title: Your rights (KVKK Art. 11)
rights.body: You may ask the data controller to:

items.1: learn whether your personal data is processed,
items.2: get information about it if so,
items.3: learn the purpose and whether it is used accordingly,
items.4: know the third parties it is transferred to in Turkey or abroad,
items.5: have incomplete or wrong data corrected,
items.6: have it deleted or destroyed under the conditions of Article 7 of the KVKK,
items.7: have corrections and deletions notified to the third parties it was transferred to,
items.8: object to a result against you that comes solely from automated analysis,
items.9: claim compensation for damage caused by unlawful processing.

contact.title: Requests
contact.body: Send your request by e-mail to {{ email }}. Requests are answered free of charge within 30 days at the latest.

meta.title: Terms of Use | {{ brand.name }}
meta.description: {{ brand.name }} terms of use: accounts, rules, content, private lessons and liability.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using {{ brand.name }} you accept these terms. Your personal data is processed under the Privacy Policy.

service.title: Service
service.body: {{ brand.name }} is a learning platform where teachers prepare and assign tests, students solve them and follow their progress, parents keep track, and private lessons take place over video. Sign-up and use are free.

accounts.title: Accounts and roles
accounts.body: You are responsible for opening your account with correct details and keeping your sign-in safe.

items.1: Teacher and private tutor accounts open after administrator approval.
items.2: Some student features open after a parent confirms.
items.3: Parent accounts are created through the student's invitation.

rules.title: Rules
rules.body: On the platform you may not:

items.1: use someone else's account or pretend to be someone else,
items.2: share insults, harassment, hate speech or content unsuitable for children,
items.3: upload or share content you have no rights to,
items.4: try to disrupt the platform, get around its security or scrape data in bulk,
items.5: use the platform for commercial advertising or referrals.

content.title: Content and rights
content.body: You keep the rights to the questions, images and texts you upload and confirm you have the permissions needed to upload them. You allow us to use your content to the extent of the visibility you choose so it can be shown on the platform. Reported content is reviewed and content against the rules may be removed.

ai.title: AI suggestions
ai.body: AI suggestions such as question classification, question detection and question generation can be wrong. Checking them and making the final decision is the teacher's responsibility.

tutoring.title: Private lessons
tutoring.body: The fee on a tutor's profile is for information; no payment is taken through the platform and {{ brand.name }} is not a party to the agreement between the tutor and the student or parent.

suspension.title: Suspension
suspension.body: Use that breaks these terms may lead to the account being restricted, suspended or closed without notice.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: We work to keep the platform available and free of errors but cannot guarantee it. Results of tools such as the score calculator are estimates and do not replace official results.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: When the terms change, the version and date on this page change; important changes are also announced in the platform.

info.title: How we calculate the {{ exam }} score ({{ year }} data)

steps.weighted: Weighted score = the standard scores added up with their subject weights.

official.lgs: The formula, net calculation, and subject weights come from MEB's 2026 report.
official.yks: The formula, net calculation, weights, 0.5 raw score requirement, and the means and standard deviations of final-year candidates come from ÖSYM documents.

estimated.lgs: MEB does not publish a mean and standard deviation per subject. We derive the standard deviation from the report's item analysis: questions × discrimination × √(difficulty × (1 − difficulty)) × 1.17. The last factor assumes that half of the answers that were not correct were wrong rather than blank. The means use the same assumption but do not change the result. For the lowest value we assume every question is wrong, and for the highest that every question is correct. This has not been compared with real exam results.
estimated.yks: ÖSYM does not publish the lowest and highest weighted scores. For the highest we assume all valid questions are correct. For the lowest we assume blank tests with a 0.5 raw score in one required test. For TYT this scale roughly fits ÖSYM's score distribution; the AYT score types could not be checked directly.

info.margin: The likely range is our judgement, not a measured margin of error: LGS ±25, TYT ±10, AYT score types ±15.
